meta.name: Resonant Sigil
meta.description: Forged by The Forge Squad of the Enclave of the 16, this captured-lightning geode channels core-metallurgy into a resonant sigil. Socketed into a tool, its sympathetic alloys shift with operator focus, redirecting wasted impact. When striking anvilstone or deep strata, ground rods tame subterranean plasma to shatter adjacent rock with the overkill.
meta.author: jules:session
